expectations: The unchanged server rejects vision-account-deletion as a required capability; this limitation is retained and reported.
A real native OAuth login and broker session precede the browser deletion request.
The public route refuses absent authentication, bad Origin, CSRF, confirmation and caller-selected owner.
A correct request creates one durable intention and returns 202 while preserving all content until external archive receipt.
The actual archive worker encrypts the intention; SMTP refusal cannot acknowledge it.
After explicitly simulated mail receipt, the actual archiver binds its SQL receipt and the unchanged HTTP route erases only the requesting Vision account.
Common native identity and another account survive; the native replay worker records and preserves the exact archive receipt.
No production, real delivery, protected authority or complete readiness claim follows from this local test.
